title: Questions to ask before your first HBOT visit in Scarsdale
intro: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy involves breathing oxygen in a pressurized chamber. Before considering an appointment, ask the Rescu team about screening, chamber type, and whether the visit is appropriate for you.
hook: Curious about your first hyperbaric oxygen visit?

facts.text: Rescu has information about its physician-led wellness and recovery services on its website.
Rescu offers hyperbaric oxygen therapy as part of its wellness and recovery services.
